hints.title: Functional Graph Structure
hints.text: Each player passes the ball to a deterministic successor, creating a functional graph with out-degree 1.

hints.title: Binary Doubling Technique
hints.text: Since k can be up to 10^10, precompute destinations and path sums for power-of-two steps up to 34 bits.

hints.title: Binary Lifting Table
hints.text: Maintain up[node][step] and sum[node][step]. For any start node, traverse the bits of k to accumulate the path sum in O(log k) time.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary lifting doubling table for jumping powers of 2.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating k steps per node requires O(n * k) steps, which times out for k = 10^10.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n log k) memory for jumping tables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply binary lifting doubling to compute jump destination and accumulated sum.
